metadata.description: Second-stage deployment: imports the mock retail OpenAPI definition into an existing API Management instance, enables CORS so the synthetic-traffic website can call the gateway directly, and onboards the API into Microsoft Defender for APIs via a Microsoft.Security/apiCollections resource. Run this AFTER infra/main.json has been deployed and the OpenAPI document is reachable at a public URL (for example the raw GitHub URL of apim/openapi.yaml once pushed to your fork).
Name of the existing API Management instance created by infra/main.json (see its apimServiceName output).
HTTPS base URL of the App Service running the mock API, e.g. https://<webAppHostName> (see infra/main.json output webAppHostName).
Publicly reachable URL to apim/openapi.yaml, for example https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<org>/<repo>/<branch>/apim/openapi.yaml.
Logical API identifier within API Management.
URL suffix the API is published under in the APIM gateway, e.g. https://<gateway>/retail.

properties.displayName: Defender for APIs Demo - Retail API
properties.description: Synthetic retail workload used to exercise Microsoft Defender for APIs detections (enumeration, data exposure, traffic/latency/payload spikes).
